query:
SELECT xref_card_num AS card_num,
                              xref_cust_id  AS cust_id,
                              xref_acct_id  AS acct_id
                         FROM card_xref
                        WHERE xref_card_num COLLATE "C" > $1
                        ORDER BY xref_card_num COLLATE "C"
                        LIMIT $2
